# Project screenshots

Drop your project screenshots / banners in this folder using the filenames below.
Card aspect ratio is **16:9** — 1600×900px (or larger at the same ratio) is ideal.

Recommended formats, in order of preference:
- `.webp` (best size/quality) → use `yardsale.webp` etc.
- `.jpg` (universal)         → `yardsale.jpg` etc.
- `.png` (only if you need transparency)

If you use `.webp`, update the `image` field in `src/data.js` accordingly.

## Expected files

| Project            | Filename                        |
|--------------------|---------------------------------|
| Yardsale           | `yardsale.jpg`                  |
| Barry Red Studio   | `barry-red.jpg`                 |
| KUVRD Core         | `kuvrd.jpg`                     |
| GardPro GearHub    | `gardpro.jpg`                   |
| Orata Crafted      | `orata.jpg`                     |
| Living Essentials  | `living-essentials.jpg`         |

If a file is missing, the card falls back to the existing gradient + project-name
placeholder — so nothing breaks while you're adding images.
